description: This file defines the exception class GenericFindException used in the org.apache.ofbiz.entity package, extending the GenericEntityException class. It provides constructors for different ways to instantiate the exception, including with a message and nested exception.

classes.name: GenericFindException
classes.description: An exception class representing errors during 'find' operations in the entity layer, extending GenericEntityException.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message and a nested throwable.
